title: Health Literacy and Self-efficacy Expectations in Patients With Alcohol-related Liver Cirrhosis
official: Gesundheitskompetenz Und Selbstwirksamkeitserwartung Bei PatientInnen Mit Alkoholbedingter Leberzirrhose
summary: The goal of this observational study is to quantify the health literacy and self-efficacy in people with alcohol-related liver cirrhosis.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age (18-99)
* liver cirrhosis

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy
* insufficient german
